reconstructed_theorem_text: Let X be an arbitrary type, let L : (X → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ) be a real-linear generator, and let α ∈ ℝ with α > 0. Assume that for every g : X → ℝ and y ∈ X, α Γ_L(g,g)(y) ≤ (1/2)(L(Γ_L(g,g))(y) - Γ_L(g,Lg)(y) - Γ_L(g,Lg)(y)). Let P_u : (X → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ), indexed by u ∈ ℝ, be order preserving: whenever f(y) ≤ g(y) for every y ∈ X, P_u f(z) ≤ P_u g(z) for every z ∈ X. Let h_u : X → ℝ be an orbit indexed by u ∈ ℝ, fix x ∈ X, and define Φ(u) = P_u(Γ_L(h_u,h_u))(x). Assume Φ is continuous on ℝ and that, for every u ∈ ℝ, its right-sided derivative at u within [u,∞) is exactly P_u(L(Γ_L(h_u,h_u)) - 2Γ_L(h_u,Lh_u))(x). Then, for every s,t ∈ ℝ with s ≤ t, P_s(Γ_L(h_s,h_s))(x) ≤ P_t(Γ_L(h_t,h_t))(x) exp(-(2α)(t-s)).
objects: An arbitrary type X; a real-linear generator L; a positive curvature parameter α; an ℝ-indexed family of real-linear evolution operators P_u; an ℝ-indexed orbit h_u : X → ℝ; a point x ∈ X; the carré-du-champ expression Γ_L; and the scalar interpolation Φ(u) = P_u(Γ_L(h_u,h_u))(x).
domains: X is arbitrary. L and every P_u are real-linear maps from X → ℝ to X → ℝ. The indices u,s,t and parameter α are real, h_u is real-valued on X, x,y,z lie in X, and Φ : ℝ → ℝ.
quantifiers: For every arbitrary type X, generator L, α ∈ ℝ with α > 0, evolution family u ↦ P_u, orbit u ↦ h_u, and x ∈ X satisfying the assumptions; and for every s,t ∈ ℝ with s ≤ t. The curvature premise ranges over every g : X → ℝ and y ∈ X; positivity ranges over every u, pointwise ordered f,g, and z ∈ X; the derivative premise ranges over every u ∈ ℝ.
assumptions: (1) 0 < α. (2) For all g and y, αΓ_L(g,g)(y) ≤ (1/2)(L(Γ_L(g,g))(y) - Γ_L(g,Lg)(y) - Γ_L(g,Lg)(y)). (3) Each P_u is order preserving on pointwise ordered functions. (4) Φ(u) = P_u(Γ_L(h_u,h_u))(x) is globally continuous. (5) For every u, the derivative of Φ within the right ray [u,∞) equals P_u(L(Γ_L(h_u,h_u)) - 2Γ_L(h_u,Lh_u))(x). (6) s ≤ t.
scopes: Curvature is pointwise for all test functions and points. Order preservation holds for every real evolution index and every pointwise ordered pair of functions. Continuity is global in u, while the derivative is one-sided within [u,∞) at every u. The endpoint condition is non-strict and includes s = t. No semigroup law, differentiability of the orbit itself, or sign condition on Φ or Γ_L is assumed.
constant_dependencies: The curvature premise contains the exact factor 1/2 and two identical mixed-term subtractions. The derivative contains exactly -2Γ_L(h_u,Lh_u). Consequently the growth rate is exactly 2α and the contraction factor is exactly exp(-(2α)(t-s)), with no further multiplicative or additive constant.
